versions.content: On reception of the UDS Service ReadDataByIdentifier (0x22), for every requested DID outside the OBD range (F400-F8FF), after all verifica- tion (see [SWS_Dcm_00433], [SWS_Dcm_00434] and [SWS_Dcm_00435]), If the data is configured as a "ECU signal" of the IoHwAb (parameter DcmDspDataUse- Port ), the Dcm shall call the Api IoHwAb_Dcm_Read<EcuSignalName >() (param- eter DcmDspDataReadEcuSignal ) to get the Data. In this case, the requirements [SWS_Dcm_00439], [SWS_Dcm_00436] and [SWS_Dcm_00437] shall not apply.
